absent-from-2014.flag: its whole text is not in the 2014 transcription
absent-from-2014.answer: 2014 line 10027 has the same rule split by '## Page 240': page break only. Re-read §2002:11.6.3 GR1: unchanged.

definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.140) object property: 'A name that may be used to qualify an object reference to get a value from or pass a value to an object'; 2023 says 'can be used'. Same concept; a) still covers GET/SET PROPERTY methods, shown by oo_property_methods at 2002.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (4.121) method: 'A procedural entity defined by a method definition within, or inherited by, a class definition'; 2023 describes methods in 9.3.4 instead. Same entity; GR1 names the method a method definition declares in both.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:9.3.5: 2002 binds by method-name alone ('if a method with the method-name specified in the invocation is defined in the class of the object, that method is bound'); 2023 9.3.6 adds signature matching (overloading). GR1 fixes the name; with one method per name the two resolutions bind the same method, so the witness as_name.cob (INVOKE by the externalized literal at 2002) shows the 2002 behaviour. Overload resolution is not part of GR1.
